title: Simulate to Generalize: Scaling Stateful Supervision for API-calling Agents using LLM World Models
summary: SimSAT uses language models to simulate stateful APIs and generate training trajectories, helping agents generalize to unseen environments on AppWorld and OfficeBench.

title: THINKSAFE: Self-Generated Safety Alignment for Reasoning Models
summary: ThinkSafe trains reasoning models on their own filtered safety examples, improving safety while keeping reasoning performance competitive.

title: It Takes Two: Complementary Self-Distillation for Contextual Integrity in LLMs
summary: SelfCI improves context-appropriate disclosure by training models to retain information needed for the task and withhold information inappropriate to share.

title: T-MAP: Red-Teaming LLM Agents with Trajectory-aware Evolutionary Search
summary: T-MAP evaluates safety at the level of tool execution and finds failures that text-only evaluations can miss.

title: Rethinking Reward Models for Multi-Domain Test-Time Scaling
summary: A comparison across 14 domains finds that generative outcome verifiers deliver the most consistent gains among four reward-model variants.

title: HoliSafe: Holistic Safety Benchmarking and Modeling with Safety Meta Token for Vision-Language Model
summary: HoliSafe benchmarks safety across combinations of images and text and adds a visual guard that helps vision-language models identify harmful images.

title: FedSVD: Adaptive Orthogonalization for Private Federated Learning with LoRA
summary: FedSVD reduces noise amplification in differentially private federated LoRA by refactoring aggregated updates into an adaptive orthogonal basis.

title: Distilling LLM Agent into Small Models with Retrieval and Code Tools
summary: Agent Distillation transfers tool use as well as reasoning from large teachers, making smaller agents competitive with larger models on factual and mathematical tasks.

title: Reliable Decision-Making via Calibration-Oriented Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: CalibRAG retrieves documents to improve the calibration of decisions informed by language models and improves accuracy across the evaluated datasets.

title: Trajectory Balance with Asynchrony: Decoupling Exploration and Learning for Fast, Scalable LLM Post-Training
summary: Trajectory Balance with Asynchrony learns from asynchronously collected experience to speed up language-model post-training while retaining strong task performance.

title: SafeRoute: Adaptive Model Selection for Efficient and Accurate Safety Guardrails in Large Language Models
summary: SafeRoute reduces moderation cost by sending difficult inputs to a larger safety model and handling easier inputs with a smaller one.

title: Personalized Fine-Tuning with Controllable Synthetic Speech from LLM-Generated Transcripts for Dysarthric Speech Recognition
summary: Personalized adaptation and synthetic dysarthric speech improve speech recognition for speakers with dysarthria.

title: HarmAug: Effective Data Augmentation for Knowledge Distillation of Safety Guard Models
summary: HarmAug uses synthetic training data to help compact safety guard models detect a broader range of harmful inputs.

title: Learning Diverse Attacks on Large Language Models for Robust Red-teaming and Safety Tuning
summary: The study finds that broader red-team coverage can improve the robustness of safety tuning against attacks outside the training set.

title: Optimized Speculative Sampling for GPU Hardware Accelerators
summary: Parallelizing speculative sampling on GPUs reduces runtime without changing output accuracy, and an additional approximation trades a small accuracy loss for more speed.

title: Drug Discovery with Dynamic Goal-aware Fragment
summary: GEAM learns and updates a vocabulary of molecular fragments relevant to target properties, improving results on the paper’s molecule-design benchmarks.

title: Effective and Efficient Conversation Retrieval for Dialogue State Tracking with Implicit Text Summaries
summary: A lightweight retriever distilled from conversation summaries improves few-shot dialogue state tracking without generating summaries at inference time.

title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation for Transfer Learning
summary: A small synthetic dataset transfers representations from a self-supervised model trained on full unlabeled data, reducing the cost of adapting to new tasks.

title: DiffusionNAG: Task-guided Neural Architecture Generation with Diffusion Models
summary: DiffusionNAG generates neural architectures as graphs and uses task-specific predictors to steer sampling toward promising designs.

title: Knowledge-Augmented Reasoning Distillation for Small Language Models in Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
summary: KARD distills reasoning supported by retrieved evidence into small language models, improving performance on knowledge-intensive tasks.

title: Scalable Set Encoding with Universal Mini-Batch Consistency and Unbiased Full Set Gradient Approximation
summary: Universal mini-batch consistency lets models process a large set in chunks while estimating the full-set training gradient without bias and with constant memory overhead.

title: Margin-based Neural Network Watermarking
summary: Margin-based watermarking strengthens ownership verification for neural networks against attempts to replicate their functionality.

title: Self-Supervised Set Representation Learning for Unsupervised Meta-Learning
summary: Set-SimCLR learns representations of sets from unlabeled images and improves few-shot classification over instance-level self-supervision and unsupervised meta-learning baselines.

title: Self-Distillation for Further Pre-training of Transformers
summary: Self-distillation regularizes continued transformer pretraining on domain data and improves downstream performance in the studied vision and language tasks.

title: Set-based Meta-Interpolation for Few-Task Meta-Learning
summary: Meta-Interpolation uses neural set functions to generate additional training tasks and improve adaptation when few source tasks are available.

title: On Divergence Measures for Bayesian Pseudocoresets
summary: The paper connects dataset distillation to Bayesian pseudocoresets through reverse KL and Wasserstein objectives and unifies the two views.

title: Set Based Stochastic Subsampling
summary: A two-stage subsampler combines coarse global context with sequential refinement to retain the input elements most useful for a downstream task.

title: Sequential Reptile: Inter-Task Gradient Alignment for Multilingual Learning
summary: Sequential Reptile aligns gradients across language tasks during meta-training to improve multilingual transfer.

title: Learning to Perturb Word Embeddings for Out-of-distribution QA
summary: Learning to perturb question and context embeddings improves question-answering performance on unseen domains.

title: Contrastive Learning with Adversarial Perturbations for Conditional Text Generation
summary: Contrastive training on positive and negative perturbations improves conditional text generation by teaching models to distinguish preserving edits from misleading ones.

title: Meta-GMVAE: Mixture of Gaussian VAE for Unsupervised Meta-Learning
summary: Meta-GMVAE learns from unlabeled examples with a Gaussian-mixture latent space and uses that structure to adapt to new few-shot classification tasks.

title: Generating Diverse and Consistent QA pairs from Contexts with Information-Maximizing Hierarchical Conditional VAEs
summary: A hierarchical generative model produces diverse question–answer pairs from unlabeled text while encouraging the questions and answers to remain consistent.

title: g2pM: A Neural Grapheme-to-Phoneme Conversion Package for Mandarin Chinese Based on a New Open Benchmark Dataset
summary: g2pM introduces an open benchmark of more than 99,000 sentences and a neural model for disambiguating Mandarin characters with multiple pronunciations.
